nodes.label: Nested objects and arrays generation
nodes.rationale: Recursion depth is capped at 3 to handle complex schemas without unbounded generation.

nodes.label: Context-aware data generation
nodes.rationale: Values are inferred from property type, format and name heuristics (emails for email fields, UUIDs for id fields, dates for date/date-time) so generated examples look realistic rather than placeholder text.

nodes.label: Layered architecture
nodes.rationale: The project is split into ui, application, domain and infrastructure layers to achieve clear separation of concerns, isolating IntelliJ UI code and external parsing concerns from business logic.
